title: Heterogeneous Vision-Language Ensemble with Disagreement-Aware Reranking for Text-Based Person Anomaly Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.12843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-based person anomaly retrieval aims to retrieve pedestrians exhibiting anomalous behaviors from a large image gallery using natural language descriptions. Compared with conventional text-based person retrieval, this task requires fine-grained reasoning over pedestrian appearance, behaviors, object interactions, and scene context, making robust cross-modal matching significantly more challenging. This paper presents the GENAI4E team's solution to AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4. Our framework builds upon a strong retrieval backbone and progressively integrates heterogeneous vision-language embedding models through score alignment and iterative ensemble fusion, followed by disagreement-aware VLM reranking for ambiguous queries. translated_title: 基于异质视觉-语言集成与分歧感知重排序的文本行人异常检索
translated_abstract: 文本行人异常检索旨在使用自然语言描述从大型图像库中检索表现出异常行为的行人。与传统文本行人检索相比，该任务需要对行人外观、行为、物体交互和场景上下文进行细粒度推理，使得鲁棒跨模态匹配更具挑战性。本文介绍了GENAI4E团队对AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4的解决方案。我们的框架基于强大的检索骨干网络，通过分数对齐和迭代集成融合逐步整合异质视觉-语言嵌入模型，随后对模糊查询进行分歧感知的VLM重排序。在官方行人异常行为（PAB）基准上，我们的方法实现了90.92%的mAP、85.13%的Recall@1、97.72%的Recall@5和98.68%的Recall@10，证明了结合互补模型的效力。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合异质视觉-语言模型集成与分歧感知重排序的框架，在文本行人异常检索任务上显著提升了跨模态匹配性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework combining heterogeneous vision-language ensemble with disagreement-aware reranking, significantly improving cross-modal matching performance for text-based person anomaly retrieval.
